title: Talon Fantasy Dagger
description: A fantasy 3D weapon resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition featuring custom dagger models and detailed textures.
body:
Talon Fantasy Dagger is a custom 3D weapon resource pack for Minecraft Java Edition focused on fantasy and medieval styled combat. This project adds detailed custom dagger models with unique textures inspired by RPG and adventure themed gameplay.

The pack is designed for players who want a more immersive combat experience while keeping Minecraft lightweight and easy to use. Every weapon model is created using custom 3D designs to give items a more realistic and fantasy-inspired appearance.

Features:

- Custom 3D dagger models
- Fantasy and medieval weapon designs
- Detailed and immersive textures
- Lightweight performance
- Compatible with Minecraft Java 1.21+
- RPG and PvP inspired style

More custom weapons and updates may be added in future versions of the project.
